title: Car Photo in Black and White
tests: Converts the supplied photo to neutral grayscale without regenerating, rearranging or cropping its contents.

faults.what: The output retains the source's approximately 5:3 aspect ratio rather than the specified 16:9; the original composition is preserved without visible cropping.

judge.summary: The image is faithfully converted to neutral black and white without visible content changes or cropping, but its retained source aspect ratio is not 16:9.

must_haves.item: The entire image is neutral black and white, with no red remaining on the car or colour elsewhere.
must_haves.why: The car, street, foliage, houses, and sky all appear neutral grayscale.

must_haves.item: The same compact hatchback remains in the same position and has unchanged body details.
must_haves.why: The car's position, silhouette, windows, wheels, lights, trim, and rear details remain visibly consistent with the original.

must_haves.item: The street and background objects retain their original positions and appearance apart from colour.
must_haves.why: The houses, trees, parked cars, utility poles, road markings and cracks, and shadows retain their original placement and appearance.

must_haves.item: The full original composition is retained without cropping, in 16:9.
must_haves.why: The full original composition is retained without visible cropping, but both supplied images are approximately 1024×614, not 16:9.
